answer: The bedrock check is Certified paperhanger wall log with paperhangers verification. Under it sits 1-year training, 184 supervised makings, quality exam, annual renewal, and no template can dig around it. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 379 fakes pay 379 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill outruns its reward. Ask for the orchard and the farm stalls, ask for the quill and the farm pays, ask for the beacon and the farm has nothing to show. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
